summary: Check two corrections to early Viridis Lean sources with the Lean kernel: the unrestricted Intelligence Bound axiom of January 2026 is false as written, and the theorem named no_finite_compensation in fact proves that a finite power increase compensates a partial loss of D. State and prove what holds instead: compensation in the interior, its limit under a power ceiling, divergence near complete loss, and impossibility at D = 0.
title: Intelligence Bound audit: compensation, ceilings and the unrestricted axiom
